verdicts.reason: A has a clean left-to-right banner structure: box, then headline and copy, then CTA. Its flaws: the box's 3D side pokes into the lime panel edge; the '48H ONLY' badge is shrunk to an unreadable flat pill jammed against the top edge; and the oversized CTA competes with the headline. B is worse: the box is shrunk to a trivial size and straddles the panel edge; the headline runs straight into the CTA pill, which overhangs the panel and nearly touches the canvas edge; and the badge is a squashed, illegible '48HONLY' scrap stranded at the bottom left.
